source.selection: finite RawPseudorangeMeters rows grouped by (utcTimeMillis,Svid), GPS L1/L5 and Galileo E1/E5a only; no enriched SvPosition/SvElevation/Wls fields were read

method.adjusted_pair_value_m: raw_pair_value_m - fixed_phase11_secondary_bias_m; primary bias is zero
method.elevation_policy: no elevation-derived statistic or parameter choice is made by this audit; the candidate obtains elevation only from native broadcast-nav geometry
method.percentile_convention: linear interpolation at (n-1)p for the raw pair descriptive statistics only

existing_correction_contract.klobuchar: ionoDelayKlobuchar is evaluated at seed geometry and scaled by (GPS_L1_FREQ/frequency)^2 per signal
existing_correction_contract.other_terms: satellite clock meters are added; Saastamoinen troposphere and broadcast group delay are subtracted
existing_correction_contract.carrier_contract: carrier adds satellite clock and ionosphere with the existing phase sign; no residual-ionosphere state is currently applied
existing_correction_contract.double_correction_guard: the new candidate must not re-estimate or reapply the static Phase11 receiver IFB or the existing Klobuchar/TGD terms

interpretation.identifiability: The common adjusted raw residual is finite and repeatable across every epoch, but this audit deliberately does not consume enriched elevation/coordinate fields. Native broadcast-nav geometry will supply the mapping in the candidate; no universal ionosphere estimate is claimed and no parameter is fit to this audit.
interpretation.candidate_rationale: A shared state with coefficient mapping(elevation)*((f_L1/f_signal)^2) is the smallest raw-only extension that can model a post-Klobuchar first-order residual while retaining Phase11 static IFB states.

audit_record_hash: computed after apply_patch and recorded by the companion freeze manifest
